input: arr contains n integers in[-1000000000,1000000000], including possibly zero and negative values. Collections are ordinary finite dense arrays/lists, not subclasses, proxies, sparse/accessor-backed collections. Strings are ordinary/primitive strings. Every collection length and computed allocation size fits [0,4294967295], with padded sizes explicitly included. No concurrent mutation or built-in monkey-patching is allowed. Preconditions are not runtime-checked, and allocation/resource capacity or completion is not guaranteed by declared bounds. JavaScript integer inputs are primitive safe-integer Number, excluding negative zero, NaN, infinities, fractions and BigInt.
return: Boolean indicating distinct indices i,j with arr[i]=2*arr[j].
mutation_aliasing: Inputs and caller-held aliases remain unchanged; only private working state is used. The Solution instance retains no state.
numeric: Doubled values lie in[-2000000000,2000000000]. Halves are used only for even integers, so Python floor division and JavaScript division agree. Insert-after-check requires two occurrences for zero. All integer inputs/intermediates remain within [-9007199254740991,9007199254740991]; no bitwise coercion is used.
complexity: Expected O(n+1) time/O(n+1) auxiliary space under bounded-key set assumptions. Bounds include ordinary built-in operations/allocations and assume bounded-word arithmetic, constant-time indexing, amortized append/pop and any explicitly stated hash/sort behavior.
source_accounting: The complete standalone source is 294 UTF-8 bytes, including every helper, Solution wrapper, signature, loop, built-in call, annotation/comment, whitespace and terminal newline. Helpers are fully charged per candidate, not free shared libraries. No imports, runtime-generated implementations or hidden source expansion are used. Any eventual judge-interface adapter is additional charged source.
evidence_boundary: Authored permitted dev_fit alternative outside frozen source sets. Membership checked only against already-public cost-decomposition-v1/contract.json partition.dev_fit and candidate manifest. Input/effect/complexity declarations are not frozen-predecessor equivalence receipts. No candidate execution/import, behavioral qualification, benchmark acceptance or M1/M2 pass is claimed. Independent source-bound isolated qualification must cover empty/singleton, two zeros versus one, negative pairs, odd values, duplicates without doubles and either input ordering, actual return types, numerical/Unicode and effect contracts, full source/adapter charges and complexity before admission or promotion.
